presence.title: Divine Presence
presence.description: Welcome to Gurudev Ashram, Akalawadi, a place dedicated to spiritual learning, self-discovery, and the cultivation of inner peace. Under the guidance of Poojya Shri Amrutanand Mahaswamiji, the ashram offers an opportunity to explore the deeper dimensions of life through spiritual teachings, yoga, meditation, and a disciplined way of living. The ashram encourages individuals to move beyond the distractions of everyday life and develop a deeper understanding of the self, the mind, and the relationship between inner well-being and purposeful living. Through its spiritual environment, ashram activities, and yoga programs, visitors can learn practices that support physical health, mental clarity, emotional balance, and spiritual growth.

about.heading: About Swamiji
about.paragraph: Poojya Shri Amrutanand Mahaswamiji is a compassionate spiritual guide, accomplished Yogacharya and inspiring social reformer dedicated to uplifting humanity through devotion, Vedic wisdom and selfless seva.
about.timelineTitle: A life dedicated to spirituality and service
timeline: Born on 1 June 1989 in Nandgaon, Athani Taluk, Belagavi District
Raised in a deeply spiritual environment with devotion to bhajans and kirtans
Joined Vijayapura Ashram and embraced a disciplined spiritual path
Studied Vachana literature, Patanjali Yoga Sutras, Narada Bhakti Sutras, Bhagavad Gita and Upanishads
Awarded the title 'Pandit' and trained in yoga under Baba Ramdev
Earned the title of Yogacharya and a doctorate in Yoga in 2016
Conducts yoga and spiritual discourses in Kannada, Marathi, Hindi and English

biography.title: Biography
biography.name: Poojya Shri Amrutanand Mahaswamiji
biography.paragraph1: Born on 1 June 1989 at Nandgaon, Athani Taluk, Belagavi District, he grew up in a tradition rooted in devotion, music, and spiritual discipline.
biography.paragraph2: His lifelong passion for bhajans and kirtans, combined with focused study of Vachana literature, yoga sutras, bhakti texts, and the Gita, shaped his mission of service and awakening.
biography.paragraph3: He joined Vijayapura Ashram, accepted Sannyasa on 6 June 2005, and later earned the titles of Pandit and Yogacharya, followed by a doctorate in Yoga in 2016.
achievements: Conducts discourses in Kannada, Marathi, Hindi and English
Dedicated to yoga, social service and spiritual education

ashram.heading: Yogashram Life & Seva
ashram.description: Whether you are seeking a place for reflection, wishing to learn yoga and meditation, or interested in experiencing ashram life, Gurudev Ashram, Akalawadi, provides a space to pause, learn, and reconnect with what truly matters. Its spiritual journey is an invitation to cultivate awareness, discipline, compassion, and a more meaningful approach to life.
